content: Implemented stdin/stdout JSON protocol v1 in `jutsu-audio-cli` for create/inspect, WAV import, clip add/update(delete/move/trim/gain), delete, and offline transport acknowledgement. CLI routes mutations through ProjectCommandEngine and atomic ProjectStore save. Success/error envelopes, explicit UUIDs, snake_case operation tags, and exit codes 0/2/3/4 documented in docs/cli.md. Validation: CLI integration tests prove create/inspect shapes and malformed-request JSON/exit code; `cargo quality` passed format, Clippy -D warnings, 42 tests, and bench compilation.
